statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis code Z86.73 is on file
Diagnosis code I49.5 is on file
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management
Prior precertification is clinically warranted for this diagnostic service
